name: What information do I need to provide for a site feasibility consultation?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to provide for a site feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a site feasibility consultation, provide the property's address or parcel number, any existing surveys or blueprints, and details about your desired tiny home's size and features. It's also helpful to share your budget and timeline expectations. This information allows us to research local regulations and assess the site more accurately, ensuring the consultation addresses your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide the property address, any surveys, and details about your tiny home's size and features. Your budget and timeline are also helpful.
